verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents an installable agent skill that lets your agent deploy agents, create sandboxes, host MCP servers and run batch jobs 'all using simple prompts, zero code required.' An official MCP server and per-sandbox MCP servers also let agents operate resources through tool calls driven by natural-language requests. Missing for 10: a native built-in natural-language interface (it relies on the user's own agent), detailed documentation of how much of the platform the skill covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
